name: Netorare: Inma no Heya
original_name: 寝取られ 淫魔の部屋
source:
A rich daughter ended up penniless and thrown out on her butt.

Couple Edition
She has no choice but to sell her body and stay in a high-end mansion, where once a week her benefactor takes her to a dark room, and amid caresses...

Single Edition
Choose to live alone and prepare for a dream-like experience of unseen indiscretions...

Which is the right path?
It's in your hands as the player.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ089902.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个富家千金最终身无分文，被抛弃了。

情侣版
她无奈，只能出卖自己的身体，住进高级豪宅，每周一次，恩人带她去暗室，在爱抚中……

单机版
选择独自生活，并为一场看不见的轻率行为的梦幻般的经历做好准备……

哪条路是正确的？
作为玩家，它掌握在你的手中。
